name: OCNLI
intro: OCNLI（Original Chinese Natural Language Inference）是首个不依赖翻译、完全从原生中文材料人工构建的大规模中文自然语言推理数据集。论文从政府、新闻、文学、电视谈话和电话对话五种体裁收集前提句，由145名中文母语的语言相关专业学生按四种策略生成56,486个前提—假设对，并通过五标签多数投票构建标准标签。
org: Indiana University, Allen Institute for Artificial Intelligence, CLUE Benchmark
build_method: 人工假设生成, 多数投票, 专家设计
eval_feature: 原生中文, 四种生成策略, 五标签复核
scale: 56,486个句对；约50k训练集、3k开发集、3k测试集
build_method_en: Human Hypothesis Elicitation, Majority Vote, Expert Design
eval_feature_en: Original Chinese, Four Elicitation Strategies, Five-label Verification
intro_en: OCNLI (Original Chinese Natural Language Inference) is the first large-scale Chinese NLI dataset constructed entirely from original Chinese material without translation. Premises come from five government, news, literature, TV-talk, and telephone genres; 145 native Chinese students in language-related majors produced 56,486 premise-hypothesis pairs under four elicitation strategies, followed by five-label majority-vote verification.

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2010.05444 Sections 3–4 and Appendices E and G plus the official CLUEbenchmark/OCNLI repository. The diagrams preserve the five original Chinese genres, Callhome cleanup and 8–50-character premise gate, 145 native Chinese undergraduate/graduate writers in Chinese or other language majors, the 70% lexical-overlap cap, exact SINGLE 11,986, MULTI 12,328, MULTI ENCOURAGE 16,584, and MULTI CONSTRAINT 15,627 counts, the 56,486-pair total, roughly 15% per-subset relabeling by four independent labelers plus the original label, 98.3–98.8% three-vote agreement, majority gold with no-majority “-”, the balanced 3k dev and 3k test split, about 50k training release and 30k train.small variant, Chinese NLI accuracy baselines, and the independent 300-item human study.
